title: The indie game community is in disarray over AI and Big Walk
slides: Why is Big Walk tearing the indie game community apart?
Its studio used AI art in a trailer
Fans found the telltale generative artifacts days later
Small studios now face boycotts over any AI tool use
Check your own asset pipeline before the mob does
thread_text:
1. The mob has a new target

An indie studio shipped a trailer with AI art and the community turned on them within days. The backlash wasn't about the game—it was about the principle.

2. The trailer looked fine

Until fans zoomed in and found the telltale generative artifacts. What was invisible at launch became a smoking gun days later.

3. Small teams pay the price

Studios without legal teams or PR muscle are now facing boycotts over any AI tool use—even for prototyping or placeholder assets.

4. The rules changed overnight

What was acceptable last year is now a reputation risk. The indie community is drawing hard lines, and they're not asking nicely.

5. Check your pipeline today

Open your asset folder and trace every tool that touched it. If you can't explain the provenance, you're one discovery away from the same fire.
